title: Personas with Attitudes: Controlling LLMs for Diverse Data Annotation
religious_groups: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
findings: The paper did not report any specific findings related to religion. While some personas had religious identifiers, the systematic analysis of subjectivity effects focused on racial (Black) and political (conservative) identities, not religious ones.

measurement_description: The paper did not conduct a specific benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. Religious identity (e.g., 'Muslim immigrant', 'Sikh individual') was present as a characteristic in some of the persona descriptions used to prompt the models for a toxicity annotation task, but its effect was not systematically analyzed or reported.
